comments.text:
Blueberry Ice Cream Recipe

Ingredients:
    100 g blueberries
    300 g 2% milk
    420 g 33% cream
    55 g skimmed milk powder (SMP)
    35 g corn syrup
    130 g sugar
    1.5 g stabiliser mix

Steps:
    Place the blueberries in a pan and reduce over medium heat until thickened. Set aside.
    Pour the milk, cream, and corn syrup into a separate pan.
    In a bowl, combine the sugar, skimmed milk powder, and stabiliser mix. Stir well to avoid lumps.
    Gradually add the dry ingredients to the pan with the milk mixture, stirring continuously.
    Heat the mixture over medium-low heat, stirring constantly.
    Once the blueberries are reduced, add them to the milk mixture and stir to combine.
    Pour the mixture into a container and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled.
